versions.changelog:
Initial release of AlphaGBM P&L Simulator.

- Simulates profit & loss for single-leg and multi-leg equity option positions, including price, IV, and time scenarios.
- Generates P&L diagrams at expiry, breakeven analysis, Monte Carlo probability distributions, and risk/reward stats.
- Supports a wide range of strategies: verticals, spreads, butterflies, iron condors, custom positions, and more.
- Provides scenario analysis for price moves, IV changes, and theta decay.
- Includes demo mock data for sample tickers (AAPL, NVDA, SPY, TSLA, META) without API key required.
